pass.meaning: 100 N, declared strength and 0.3 mm displacement criteria pass numerically. No physical qualification.

fail.meaning: 200 N, same strength and 0.3 mm criteria: converged displacement exceeds its limit.

indeterminate.meaning: 100 N elastic solution, but strength data/failure criterion missing. Do not rank or issue capacity.

iteration.meaning: 200 N, width increased from 10 to 20 mm; same task physics and criteria as fail. Numerical improvement only.
